import re

def parse(lines):
    skip = []
    src = []
    srcl = []
    ent = []
    entl = []
    caps = []
    capl = []
    term = ''
    tok = re.compile(r'((?:\\.|[^,\\])+),')
    capre = re.compile(r'^([^=#@\s]+)(?:=(.*)|#(.*)|(@))?$', re.S)
    srcre = re.compile(r'^#\s*Reconstructed via infocmp from file:\s*(?P<file>\S(?:.*\S)?)\s*$')
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        if l.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            m = srcre.match(l.strip())
            if m:
                src.append({'file': m.group('file')})
                srcl.append(i)
            else:
                skip.append(i)
            continue
        if not l[0].isspace():
            h = l.strip()
            if h.endswith(','):
                h = h[:-1]
            parts = h.split('|')
            term = parts[0]
            desc = parts[-1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
            aliases = '|'.join(parts[1:-1]) if len(parts) > 2 else ''
            ent.append({'name': term, 'aliases': aliases, 'description': desc})
            entl.append(i)
            continue
        found = False
        for t in tok.findall(l):
            t = t.strip()
            if not t:
                continue
            m = capre.match(t)
            if not m:
                continue
            found = True
            if m.group(2) is not None:
                typ = 'string'
                val = m.group(2)
            elif m.group(3) is not None:
                typ = 'numeric'
                val = m.group(3)
            elif m.group(4):
                typ = 'cancelled'
                val = ''
            else:
                typ = 'boolean'
                val = 'true'
            caps.append({'terminal': term, 'capability': m.group(1), 'type': typ, 'value': val})
        if found:
            capl.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if src:
        blocks.append({'name': 'source', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': srcl, 'records': src})
    if ent:
        blocks.append({'name': 'entries', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': entl, 'records': ent})
    if caps:
        blocks.append({'name': 'capabilities', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': capl, 'records': caps})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
